title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body: Please consider these complete packages for the stated requirement. A valid competing offer is EUR 33 per unit (offer:70240-1); please improve your complete package. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%. Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 80.8% (sc:70210@2026Q3).

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hallo, I checked your numbers and you make fair points about the material index and our delivery last quarter. I can drop the price to 31.00 EUR for 35 days lead time to beat that other offer, but we must keep payment at 30 days. We need the cash flowing to keep the shop running smoothly for you.

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and rival quote and delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We have free capacity for your parts. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo Herr Dralveck,

Thank you for the quick revision and for checking our data. We value you as a reference partner for the HX series.

Your previous scorecard records 1997 ppm (sc:70210@2026Q2).

You mentioned that cash flow matters to your shop. Our second package therefore offers faster payment, at 14 days, to support your liquidity. Both packages cover the full volume of 4200 pc per year over 24 months, with free capacity on your second shift.

Which of the two packages can you sign? Is there a cheaper variant, for example in material sourcing or batch sizes, that would lower your cost further?

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We have already taken that quality record data into account. 

Hallo, the 14 days payment is good for our cash, so I can do 28.50 EUR for that package. Our current offer is a price of €28.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €28.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – complete packages
messages.body:
Hallo Frau Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for your quote for the HX pump shaft.

Our should-cost estimate for part:320070 is EUR 36.87 per unit (cost:320070), below your price. A valid competing offer is EUR 28.5 per unit (offer:70210-2); please improve your complete package. We read that Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03); our volume fills capacity you have free, and we expect that to show in your price.

The attached packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months at your standard lead time.

Which package can you sign? Is there a cheaper variant, such as lot size or tolerances, that would lower your cost?

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – complete packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the news data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Hallo, we can do the 30 days payment and 35 days lead time. Since we do have some capacity to fill, I'm dropping the price to €30.00 per unit to get this running. So, our offer is a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

If you want to discuss tolerances to make it cheaper, our guys can look at it. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.06 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.79 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.49 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

messages.subject: HX pump shaft – closing the gap on the 14-day package
messages.body:
Hallo Frau Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for the clear step and for the cost-saving options from your team. We appreciate it.

We are keeping your preferred 14-day payment as the lead package, because it supports your cash flow. The second package, with 30-day payment, is an option if that suits your planning better. Both cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months at a 35-day lead time. That gives your machines a steady base load from January 2027.

We are close. Could you meet us on the lead package so we can finalise the HX award with you? We will also review your material and tolerance proposals with our engineering team.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: HX pump shaft – closing the gap on the 14-day package
messages.body:

So here is our Angebot: a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
